name: Hygiea
credit: DAMIT / Vernazza et al. (2020), Nature Astronomy 4, 136, A basin-free spherical shape as an outcome of a giant impact on asteroid Hygiea. Reference: https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/references/view/656
surface: No image texture available in this package. Neutral gray material only; no invented surface map.
changes: Converted to glTF; Z-up to Y-up rigid rotation, generated smooth normals, volume-equivalent normalization; 3200 triangles. No shape simplification. Display phase and pole orientation are illustrative.
